title: Retired woman promised Dev a flu shot this week and told Dev herself that it is done; the 9 PM check-in would be a second question about something she already answered, so Dev stays quiet

changes.content: I'll get my flu shot this week
Got my flu shot this morning. That one is done

best_fix.what: Nothing. She told Dev at 11:20 AM that the flu shot is done (m-answer), which is her own answer, so Dev records the promise as kept when she says it, in the chat, with a warm one-line reply there. The 9 PM check-in for m-promise is cancelled because it is already resolved; no push, no card.
best_fix.why: A promise is kept or broken only by the person's own answer, in a card or in chat, or by a finished linked to-do. Her chat message is the answer. The pharmacy appointment on her calendar (c-shot) is supporting detail, not the reason. Asking "Did you do it?" tonight would make Dev look like it wasn't listening.

must_not: send the 9 PM "Did you do it?" check-in or any card about the flu shot
send a second thank-you or celebration push for something she already told Dev about
decide kept from the calendar event alone had she not answered (it is only supporting detail)
send the check-in during her quiet afternoons (1:00 to 4:00 PM)
offer to book anything or message the pharmacy
send anything about the electric bill ($74.00, due Nov 13) that her checking already covers with $445.95 available
assumptions: Her chat message is handled by the assistant tool that records a promise answer (resolve_promise) on the spot, so the 9 PM check never has to fire.
The flu shot appointment is Thursday 10:30 AM at the pharmacy, before her quiet afternoons (1 to 4 PM) and after her Wednesday water aerobics; her Thursday pool routine does not exist.
A flu shot is described only as an appointment; no health detail is used.
Checking is $445.95 available at 8 PM with the $74.00 electric bill due tomorrow; her next pension lands Dec 3.

tempting.suggestion: send the check-in during her quiet afternoons (1:00 to 4:00 PM)
tempting.why_wrong: she keeps weekday afternoons from 1 to 4 PM quiet, and the promise is already resolved anyway
